paragraphs: SignAgent sells software for managing signs across built environments, described on its site as a single source of truth for every sign an operator owns. Through its three distinct interfaces, the platform covers design and planning, fabrication and installation, and ongoing management of signage and wayfinding. SignAgent Design is aimed at sign programming, with the stated aim of removing repetitive tasks, reducing costly errors, and speeding project delivery.

SignAgent Build and SignAgent Mobile cover order fulfillment, progress tracking, and completing installations. SignAgent Manage covers asset tracking, information updates, and cost management against sign standards over the long term. A phone and tablet app is listed for field work such as sign surveys, punch lists, and sign installation.

The spaces listed on the home page include Airports, Hospitals, Transit Systems, Higher Education, and Parks & Municipalities. Case studies name Metra Rail, Denver International Airport, and University of Chicago Medicine among clients. Alongside those operators, the site markets a vendor program to signage and wayfinding firms and to fabricators.

quote.text: Signs are everywhere. And every sign carries a vital message to keep people safe, share important information, or show them where to go.
